findings.message: Only 9.6% of the frame has scene texture.
findings.cause: Most of the frame is flat: the scene is missing, tiny, huge or behind the camera. Typical causes: a scale off by 100x, a camera pointed away, a model that failed to load.
findings.fix: Check node scale against asset bounds, the camera target and distance, and REQUEST_FAILED / RUNTIME_DIAGNOSTIC_ERROR findings.
